M1891 must keep controller-family ranking blocked

route to adapter repair if design finds missing metadata
route to branch synthesis if measured execution remains blocked

admission_evidence: M1890 audits M1889 preflight as clean and count-complete
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1891 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for repaired runner implementation or execution command design

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; execution design does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: Design must preserve controller profile controls for later current-response finite-window GRU comparison.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If repaired execution cannot be designed cleanly, route to adapter repair rather than weakening self-ID claim standards.
allowed_claims: no reset, rollout, measured execution, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A repaired bounded-smoke execution protocol can be designed from M1889 artifacts without actor input changes or ranking claims.
success_criteria: design specifies 576 rollout rows and 384 import rows
design specifies repaired runner or wrapper requirements
design keeps controller-family ranking and paper claims blocked
failure_criteria: design changes actor inputs or tunes controller profiles
decision_rule: M1891 passes if it designs a clear repaired bounded-smoke execution route without running rollout or ranking.
